headline: QC Court Issues Arrest Warrant Against VP Sara Duterte in Grave Threats Case
seoTitle: Sara Duterte Arrest Warrant Issued in Grave Threats Case | FMB News
seoDescription: A Quezon City court has issued an arrest warrant against Vice President Sara Duterte in the grave threats case, her lawyer said on September 4, 2026.
deck: Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyer confirmed that a Quezon City court issued a warrant of arrest in the grave threats case. A DOJ source separately confirmed the issuance to GMA News.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: A Quezon City court has issued a warrant of arrest against Vice President Sara Duterte in connection with the grave threats case filed against her, according to her lawyer Paul Lawrence Lim on Friday, September 4.

A Department of Justice source separately confirmed the issuance of the warrant to GMA News. Duterte’s counsel said she does not intend to evade the law and will continue to pursue available legal remedies.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Department of Justice filed three counts of grave threats in August over Duterte’s November 2024 remarks involving President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos and then-House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

Duterte’s camp challenged the case on jurisdictional grounds and sought to quash the charges. The court held oral arguments on that motion in August. Prosecutors had recommended bail of ₱120,000 for each count.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The warrant adds a separate criminal proceeding to the vice president’s already consequential legal and political situation while her impeachment trial continues before the Senate.
Issuance of an arrest warrant is not a finding of guilt. The criminal case remains subject to court proceedings, defenses and legal remedies available to Duterte.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the warrant’s service, any posting of bail, and further orders from the Quezon City court on Duterte’s pending jurisdictional challenge and motion to quash.
FMB News will update this story when the court, Duterte’s legal team or the Department of Justice releases additional verified details.
